suits.name: Spades
suits.about: polls and probes: seeing what changed

suits.name: Hearts
suits.about: rechecks and verification: is it really so

suits.name: Diamonds
suits.about: writing to the cloud and reading it back

suits.name: Clubs
suits.about: the chain, the logs and the canon

cards.title: The Blip
cards.principle: One reading is not a trend: a count can drop to zero and come back.
cards.tradeoffs: React to every blip and you chase ghosts; ignore them all and you miss the real outage.
cards.practice: Treat a single odd reading as a question, not an answer.
cards.journal: The Lake read empty 38 times. All 29 rechecked readings found the data still there.
cards.power: Blip: as an event, needs no answer

cards.title: First Poll
cards.principle: The first look records everything as observed: that is the baseline.
cards.tradeoffs: A baseline taken on a bad day makes every later day look like recovery.
cards.practice: Log the whole state once before logging changes.
cards.journal: The first poll wrote 19 observed events and a whole chain.

cards.title: The Interval
cards.principle: Poll as fast as the thing changes, no faster.
cards.tradeoffs: Short intervals cost calls and noise; long ones miss short outages.
cards.practice: Pick the cadence from the system, then keep it steady.
cards.journal: Five-minute polls, with a ten-minute burst at one-minute polls when the owner asked.

cards.title: Read-Only Probe
cards.principle: The watcher never writes to what it watches.
cards.tradeoffs: Read-only probes can't fix anything; they can only report.
cards.practice: Separate the eyes from the hands.
cards.journal: Every probe was a list, an info or a SELECT.

cards.title: Balance Probe
cards.principle: One stage's count minus the next stage's count is the work stuck between them.
cards.tradeoffs: A balance can be off for good reasons (pre-ledger objects), so it needs a known baseline.
cards.practice: Watch the handoffs, not just the totals.
cards.journal: The owner asked: "the inter task logic please watch".

cards.title: Separate Sink
cards.principle: Watch data goes to its own store, never into the watched one.
cards.tradeoffs: A second store is one more thing to keep, but it can't trigger or distort the pipeline.
cards.practice: Never let the measurement become part of the thing measured.
cards.journal: Writing into the Lake's ingest folders would have fired ingestion and changed the counts.

cards.title: Threshold of Three
cards.principle: Flag only after three polls in a row.
cards.tradeoffs: Higher thresholds miss short real outages; lower ones cry wolf.
cards.practice: Count consecutive readings before you raise a flag.
cards.journal: Every Lake blip lasted one poll, so no flag fired.

cards.title: The Unaccounted Eight
cards.principle: A finding is not an explanation.
cards.tradeoffs: Leaving a finding open is honest but leaves work undone.
cards.practice: Record the number, say it is unexplained, and ask before investigating.
cards.journal: Eight objects sat in the Lake with no ledger row. Recorded, not yet explained.

cards.title: The Hourly Round
cards.principle: Watch in rounds: twelve polls, then load.
cards.tradeoffs: Rounds batch the writes, but a crash mid-round leaves events unloaded.
cards.practice: End every round with a load and a read-back.
cards.journal: When the watch closed at night, the last eight events were loaded by hand: 342 on both sides.

cards.title: Filtered Monitor
cards.principle: Silence the noise, never the record.
cards.tradeoffs: A filter can hide a new pattern that looks like the old one.
cards.practice: Filter what you're told about, but keep every event in the chain.
cards.journal: The known Lake flap was filtered from alerts; all of it stayed in the event log.

cards.title: Stall Alarm
cards.principle: Silence is not success.
cards.tradeoffs: An alarm on silence fires when the watcher is merely slow.
cards.practice: Watch the watcher: alarm if it stops polling.
cards.journal: Twelve minutes without a poll would sound the alarm. It never sounded.

cards.title: Two Runs, One Chain
cards.principle: Never run two watchers on one chain.
cards.tradeoffs: One watcher is a single point of failure; two fork the record.
cards.practice: Stop one run before starting the next.
cards.journal: The five-minute run was stopped before the one-minute burst began.

cards.title: The Watchtower
cards.principle: Something has to stay awake.
cards.tradeoffs: A tower that never sleeps costs attention all night.
cards.practice: Give watching its own place, its own log and its own name.
cards.journal: The owner asked: "we need a memalloc watch tower".
cards.power: Head of the Chain: answers any event

cards.title: Readable
cards.principle: When the count says empty, fetch the newest thing by name.
cards.tradeoffs: A readable object proves that object, not every object.
cards.practice: Answer a scary number with a direct look.
cards.journal: Every recheck came back readable: a stats drop, not lost data.
cards.power: Blip: as an event, needs no answer

cards.title: Missing
cards.principle: The other answer: the key does not exist. That is a real outage.
cards.tradeoffs: A check that has never said 'missing' has never been proven to.
cards.practice: Know what failure looks like before you need to see it.
cards.journal: Zero missing results, live. A made-up key proved the path works.

cards.title: Test the Failure
cards.principle: Break it on purpose before it breaks for real.
cards.tradeoffs: Fake failures take time and can't cover everything.
cards.practice: Feed the check a made-up key and watch it refuse.
cards.journal: A made-up API key got HTTP 401 and was reported as refused.

cards.title: Verify Before Claiming
cards.principle: Check each 'done' in the same step as saying it.
cards.tradeoffs: Verification slows every claim a little.
cards.practice: Never report from memory what you can read from the record.
cards.journal: Every load was followed by a hash read-back before it was called loaded.

cards.title: Count the Real Number
cards.principle: Count from the record, not from what you happened to see.
cards.tradeoffs: Recounting takes a query; guessing takes nothing and costs trust.
cards.practice: When you state a count, run the count.
cards.journal: 'Fifth today' was wrong. The chain said 26 that day, and the log got a correction.

cards.title: Absence Needs a Scope
cards.principle: Say what was searched and what was not.
cards.tradeoffs: A scoped answer is longer and less satisfying than 'none'.
cards.practice: Unsearched is unknown, not clear.
cards.journal: Searches named their drives, folders and file patterns, and what they skipped.

cards.title: Twenty-Five Runs
cards.principle: A test passes when it passes twenty-five times.
cards.tradeoffs: Repetition costs minutes; flaky tests cost days.
cards.practice: Rerun the suite until luck is ruled out.
cards.journal: Skills and stores here passed 25 of 25 runs before anyone called them done.

cards.title: Read the Whole Error
cards.principle: The last line of an error is not the error.
cards.tradeoffs: Digging into logs takes time when the fix might be a retry.
cards.practice: Find the real cause before choosing the fix.
cards.journal: A loader failure printed only '}'. The tool's own log said: authentication error, code 10000.

cards.title: Retry Once
cards.principle: Retry only when the write is idempotent.
cards.tradeoffs: Retries hide intermittent faults if nobody records them.
cards.practice: Same key, same bytes, insert-or-ignore: then retry once, and log it.
cards.journal: The refused load went through on the retry, both copies read back.

cards.title: Don't Retry What Blocks
cards.principle: Some checks hurt the thing they check.
cards.tradeoffs: Skipping the retry leaves the data older.
cards.practice: If a read stops a service, take the older copy instead.
cards.journal: A database export pauses its queries, so the older ledger dump was used.

cards.title: Second Check
cards.principle: When the first number looks wrong, ask a second way.
cards.tradeoffs: Every second check is another call and another thing to keep.
cards.practice: Pair each risky number with an independent look.
cards.journal: Added the day the owner said: "Yes, add it".

cards.title: Tamper Test
cards.principle: A record that can be edited is not a record.
cards.tradeoffs: Locked tables can't fix their own typos.
cards.practice: Try to change it. It should refuse.
cards.journal: An UPDATE on the watch table was refused by its trigger. Zero rows changed.

cards.title: Chain Whole
cards.principle: The chain verifies end to end, and the cloud head matches.
cards.tradeoffs: Full verification grows with the chain.
cards.practice: Verify the whole chain, not just the newest link.
cards.journal: 342 events, chain whole, head matched in the cloud database.
cards.power: Head of the Chain: answers any event

cards.title: Nothing New
cards.principle: A load with nothing to send says so and stops.
cards.tradeoffs: Quiet loads are easy to mistake for broken ones.
cards.practice: Make 'nothing to do' an explicit, logged result.
cards.journal: A second load right after the first reported nothing new.
cards.power: Blip: as an event, needs no answer

cards.title: Object First
cards.principle: Put the object, then insert the rows that point to it.
cards.tradeoffs: If the rows fail, an object sits with no row until the retry.
cards.practice: Order writes so a failure leaves something you can redo.
cards.journal: The object landed before the database refused; the retry finished the pair.

cards.title: Read-Back Hash
cards.principle: Fetch what you wrote and hash it.
cards.tradeoffs: Every read-back doubles the transfer.
cards.practice: Don't trust the upload's word; trust the hash.
cards.journal: Every object's sha256 was read back and matched.

cards.title: Head Match
cards.principle: The newest row's hash must equal the local head.
cards.tradeoffs: A head match proves the end, not every row in the middle.
cards.practice: Compare heads after every load.
cards.journal: Each round ended with the database head matching the local chain.

cards.title: Insert or Ignore
cards.principle: Loads are idempotent: sending twice changes nothing.
cards.tradeoffs: Ignoring duplicates can hide a duplicate that differs.
cards.practice: Key every row so a resend is harmless.
cards.journal: Retries never doubled a row.

cards.title: Only Whole Lines
cards.principle: Send only lines that end in a newline.
cards.tradeoffs: The newest line waits a round.
cards.practice: A line still being written waits for the next load.
cards.journal: Half-written lines never reached the cloud.

cards.title: Prefix Hash
cards.principle: Hash everything up to each line to catch a rewrite of an earlier one.
cards.tradeoffs: One more hash per line.
cards.practice: Checking only the last line misses a change further up.
cards.journal: The offline test caught exactly that, and prefix hashes went in.

cards.title: Code Ten Thousand
cards.principle: Intermittent refusals are real; record them even when the retry works.
cards.tradeoffs: An intermittent fault is hard to report and harder to fix.
cards.practice: Log every refusal with its code and what it hit.
cards.journal: Authentication error 10000 came and went on exports and one load.

cards.title: The Last Eight
cards.principle: When the watcher stops, check what it left unloaded.
cards.tradeoffs: Hand loads break the routine.
cards.practice: Compare local count to cloud count after every stop.
cards.journal: Events 335 to 342 were loaded by hand after the watch closed.

cards.title: Fourteen Formats
cards.principle: Every format is read back, or it doesn't count.
cards.tradeoffs: More formats, more ways to be subtly wrong.
cards.practice: Write it, read it, compare row counts and the longest value.
cards.journal: CSV through SPSS, Stata, SAS, SQLite and xlsx: all read back.

cards.title: Fresh Folder
cards.principle: Each export and run goes into a new folder.
cards.tradeoffs: Folders pile up.
cards.practice: Never reuse a run folder; keep the old ones as they were.
cards.journal: Runs one to seven all kept, each with its own manifest.

cards.title: The Manifest
cards.principle: A manifest lists every file's hash, taken after the file is final.
cards.tradeoffs: Hashing late means holding the file open longer.
cards.practice: Hash shared files once, after they close.
cards.journal: One manifest had 17 stale hashes for a shared file. Fixed: 234 of 234 now match.

cards.title: Local Equals Cloud
cards.principle: The job is done when both sides hold the same thing.
cards.tradeoffs: Two copies to keep in step.
cards.practice: End every session with local count = cloud count.
cards.journal: 342 local, 342 in the cloud.
cards.power: Head of the Chain: answers any event

cards.title: Append Only
cards.principle: Never delete, never overwrite: add alongside.
cards.tradeoffs: Stores only grow.
cards.practice: Write new files; correct with new lines.
cards.journal: Every run, log and canon entry here was added, not replaced.
cards.power: Blip: as an event, needs no answer

cards.title: Genesis
cards.principle: A chain starts at sixty-four zeros.
cards.tradeoffs: Starting a new chain splits history.
cards.practice: One genesis per chain, written down.
cards.journal: The canon and the watch chain each begin at all zeros.

cards.title: Prev
cards.principle: Each entry names the hash of the one before.
cards.tradeoffs: A broken link breaks everything after it.
cards.practice: Verify the link before adding the next.
cards.journal: The canon append refuses a fork, a break or a tampered file.

cards.title: Document Every Step
cards.principle: Missing notes count as work not done.
cards.tradeoffs: Logging takes time from the work.
cards.practice: Write the log line as it happens, not after.
cards.journal: Seven logs, 187 lines, every one a row in the session table.

cards.title: Owner's Words, Exactly
cards.principle: Quote the owner exactly; mark your own reading as yours.
cards.tradeoffs: Exact quotes keep typos and slang.
cards.practice: Never paraphrase inside quotation marks.
cards.journal: "record everything please"

cards.title: Corrections Are Appends
cards.principle: A wrong time or count is fixed with a new line.
cards.tradeoffs: The wrong line stays visible.
cards.practice: Say what was wrong, what is right, and why.
cards.journal: A hand-written time and a wrong count were both corrected this way.

cards.title: Metrics, Not Text
cards.principle: Keep sessions as numbers, never their words.
cards.tradeoffs: You lose what was said.
cards.practice: Times, sizes, counts and tool names only.
cards.journal: Over eleven thousand messages kept as metrics, with no text.

cards.title: The Lock
cards.principle: One writer at a time in the shared notes.
cards.tradeoffs: Waiting for the lock delays the note.
cards.practice: Take it, write, release it, and say so.
cards.journal: Every house-notes entry here was written under the lock and released.

cards.title: Hand-Over Note
cards.principle: Leave the state where the next one can pick it up.
cards.tradeoffs: Notes go stale.
cards.practice: Say what is done, what is waiting, and on whom.
cards.journal: The hand-over note grew one dated update at a time.

cards.title: Scrub Before Public
cards.principle: Nothing private leaves the house by accident.
cards.tradeoffs: Scrubs strip useful detail.
cards.practice: Check for IDs, storage names, paths and secrets before anything goes public.
cards.journal: The lore entry passed its scrub with zero hits.

cards.title: The Lore
cards.principle: A session can become a story without losing its facts.
cards.tradeoffs: Story invites embellishment.
cards.practice: Take the facts from the chain; mark the reading as yours.
cards.journal: Canon-003, The Watchtower: the Lake that kept leaving.

cards.title: Varsity Squad
cards.principle: Praise goes on the record too.
cards.tradeoffs: Praise can make a record vain.
cards.practice: Record it in the owner's words and keep working.
cards.journal: "varsity-squad-session" — "(thats high praise)"

cards.title: Head of the Chain
cards.principle: The newest entry is the one everything points back through.
cards.tradeoffs: The head is only as good as every link below it.
cards.practice: Know your head hash and check it often.
cards.journal: The canon head moved to The Watchtower and verified at seven entries.
cards.power: Head of the Chain: answers any event
